row.team_price_text: Pro: starts at $17/mo per account (1-200 labels/month; $205/year billed annually)
row.evidence: Shippo's help centre says Pro and Premier customers add users by email invite from Settings > Users, and sign-in is email and password or 'Continue with Google'; help-centre searches for SSO, SCIM and Okta return nothing, and the API reference has no user endpoints.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Plans: Starter free (1 user login, 30 labels/month), Pro starts at $17/mo (priced by label volume; 10% off annually, $205/year at 1-200 labels) and Premier (Contact us, 15+ user logins). Pricing is per account and label volume, so per-user fields are null. Users are invited manually and all have the same permissions as the Account Owner, with no change history. Sign-in is email/password with emailed 2FA codes, or Google Sign-In (social login, not SAML SSO). No SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM, JIT or user-management API is documented; the Shippo REST API (ShippoToken auth) covers shipping objects, and Platform Accounts create managed merchant accounts, not users. No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app found (404).

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 1 user login, up to 30 labels per month. Only email/password or Google Sign-In is documented.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: Starts at $17/mo (10% savings annually, $205/year at 1-200 labels per month)
plans.notes: Pricing page says up to 5 user logins; help centre says up to 300 login users (see conflicts).

scim.notes: available=false by absence: help-centre search for 'scim', 'sso' and 'okta' returns 0 articles; docs index has no SCIM page.

user_api.notes: available=false: the API reference covers addresses, shipments, rates, transactions (labels), tracking, carriers and similar shipping objects; no user or team endpoints. Platform Accounts can create Managed Shippo Accounts for a platform's merchants, which are separate accounts, not users. audit_log_api false because the help centre says there is no change history.

google.notes: 'Continue with Google' consumer sign-in only; not a Google Workspace SAML app.

fallbacks.notes: Users can only be invited by email and must not already have a Shippo account. CSV import exists for orders, not users.
